text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Passing by a ramen shop, I swear that I hear King Halo's voice coming from within, and decide to take a peek inside.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Hooray! SPE-CIAL WEEK! HOORAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! That was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! You completed the Mega-Sized Challenge!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The way everyone cheered you on at the Fan Fest was incredible! It moved me to tears!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí! Your fans were all on the edge of their seats, hollering their hearts out! I'd love to be on the receiving end of such aplausos at least once!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Heehee! Well, it wasn't that impressive!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I know! Why don't I bestow some royal encouragement to you all instead? Come, rejoice at my generosity!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Huh? You'll cheer for us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …So, apparently, that's how King Halo ended up making rounds and cheering for her friends.
choice_data_list: You must really be serious about this if you're all dressed up for it.
You must really be serious about this if you're all dressed up for it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But of course! Did you think I would offer anything less than my first-rate support?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I designed this outfit myself, specifically for my role as a cheerleader!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It is absolutely crucial if I am to provide first-rate cheering!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now come, to our next destination!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, I'm unwittingly assigned to be her attendant. I am concerned about how this will unfold, though, so I follow along as told.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Hooray! SEI-UN SKY! Do your best! Do your—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Um… Could you please direct your encouragement toward that there boulder?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pardon me? At that boulder? Well, as you wish…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do your best! Do your best! Hooray for Sky! Hooray!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're here! Por favor, join me in cheering for Mambo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Mambo? And who is that?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mambooo! You've gotta nail this next somersault!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Um, ah… I'm not sure whom I'm addressing, but do your best! Do your best! MA-M-BO!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you for being mindful of our setting and adjusting your encouragement accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm, yes… I think I'll arrange today's flowers with your support as the motif…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant… Huff… Traveling about and offering encouragement is actually rather taxing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: From this? Absurd! Today has been an absolute picnic!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And more importantly, my first-rate support was phenomenal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems proud of her efforts, even if some of her cheering was directed at inanimate objects… I hope the boulder and flowers felt encouraged.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Muchas gracias for your support today! Mambo seemed to really like the cadencia of your cheering and finally got the hang of somersaulting!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You granted me a new perspective from which to arrange flowers. I'd be obliged if you could cheer for me again in the future.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You got the fish from that rock pool to come out too. It was fun. It's nice when things get a little lively sometimes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Your encouragement helped me lots too, King! I was able to finish a whole Mega-Sized portion of noodles in record speed!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If you ever need any help, feel free to tell us! We'll do our best to s'pport you, too!
choice_data_list: Your tour was a massive success!
Your tour was a massive success!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh… Hmph! I'm too flawless to ever need anyone's assistance!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But I commend you for recognizing my true brilliance!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do inform me if you require further encouragement in the future. Should I feel so inclined, I might just lend you my support again!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're so brave for saying that with a red face! ♪ Ooh, you must be trying to hide how embarrassed you are!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I hate to disappoint you, but I'll not rise to your ribbing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This experience has simply reminded me of my own excellence! That's all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo laughs raucously with an utterly delighted look on her face.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah… It only looks that way because of the sunset. Such gratitude is nothing out of the ordinary for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she says it's the setting sun that's reddening her cheeks, then I see no reason to question it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You dolt! I'm not blushing in the slightest! I'm just touched by—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, so that's it. ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! You didn't hear that! Come now, what are you all smiling about?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, King Halo remains as evasive about her true feelings as ever.
